title: Iteration of the sampling step
statement: For all bit strings $Nw$, $Lw$, $r$, and $out$, and every natural number $j$, iterating the sampling step $j$ times on the encoding of the pair $(Nw,Lw)$ and the pair $(r,out)$ gives the encoding of $(Nw,Lw)$ and a pair whose first component is obtained from $r$ by deleting its first $j\,|Lw|$ bits. Its second component is $out$ if $out$ is nonempty; if $out$ is empty, it is the encoding of the sample returned by making at most $j$ sampling tries with threshold given by the binary value of $Nw$, using blocks of length $|Lw|$ from $r$.
hypotheses_covered: bit strings $Nw,Lw,j$? Actually $j$ is a natural number
